missing_information_behavior: Do not calculate or suggest a performance dose without total habitual caffeine, event timing, sleep, pregnancy and cardiovascular/medication context.
safety_exclusions: Do not generalize performance effects to all sports or individuals.
Do not recommend caffeine to compensate for inadequate sleep.
Do not infer a dose from body weight without a separately reviewed protocol and safety screening.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, cardiovascular disease/arrhythmia, uncontrolled hypertension, anxiety/panic, insomnia or stimulant medication use.
Adolescents, adverse reactions or very high habitual intake.
population_and_context: Adults considering caffeine for endurance or selected intermittent high-intensity sports performance; effects and safety depend on dose, timing, habitual intake and individual context.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Any protocol must be separately appraised, account for all caffeine sources and follow life-stage guidance and product labeling.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet reviews performance evidence and safety. Benefits vary by activity and dose; sleep disruption and individual sensitivity are important limitations.
